name: Standalone Finance Management System
description: Enterprise HORECA transaction core and predictive financial analytics suite featuring Philippine Tax compliance (BIR 2550M/2307/1601-C/1702), Datarails FP&A consolidation & scenario modeling, Fleet Operations & Logistics telematics, separated Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable with daily incremental overdue penalty tracking, Cash & Liquidity treasury management with Philippine Peso (₱) standardization, and unified multi-format export reporting.
